supplements.title: Significance of GSH and H2S regulation for cancer: an intricate interplay between diet, microbiota, metabolic reprogramming, and immune health.
supplements.summary: Cancer cells overproduce protective molecules GSH and H2S to survive stress, offering potential targets for new treatment strategies.

supplements.title: Prediction of molecular targets for zedoary turmeric oil in inhibiting proliferation and inducing apoptosis in non‑small cell lung cancer.
supplements.summary: Zedoary turmeric oil inhibits non-small cell lung cancer growth by targeting the EGFR/PI3K/Akt signaling pathway.

supplements.title: Urea cycle dysregulation and arginine pathways in the pathogenesis of NAFLD and NASH (Review).
supplements.summary: Restoring urea cycle function and arginine metabolism through supplementation could treat fatty liver disease by reducing inflammation and improving liver health.

supplements.title: Plant‑derived natural products alleviate dexamethasone‑induced skeletal muscle atrophy by modulating FoxO (Review).
supplements.summary: Plant-derived compounds protect against steroid-induced muscle atrophy by regulating the FoxO protein through multiple cellular pathways.

supplements.title: Fisetin Modulates Chemoresistance-Associated miR-21, miR-181a, miR-203, miR-101 and miR-381 in Capecitabine-Resistant HT29 Colorectal Cancer Cells.
supplements.summary: Fisetin, a natural compound, reverses drug resistance in colorectal cancer by altering five microRNAs that control chemotherapy response.

supplements.title: Antimalarial compounds from Solanum nigrum: In vitro antiplasmodial evaluation and network pharmacology-based investigation of host immunomodulatory mechanisms.
supplements.summary: Researchers identified antimalarial compounds in Solanum nigrum plant and analyzed how they work against malaria parasites using network analysis.

supplements.title: Multi-target mechanisms of Banxia Baizhu Tianma Decoction against MASH in a methionine-choline deficient mouse model: insights from a Multi-Omics Investigation.
supplements.summary: A traditional Chinese herbal formula reduced liver damage in mice with metabolic dysfunction-associated steatohepatitis through multiple biological pathways.

supplements.title: A study on the network pharmacology of HQGZWWT that prevents CINP by inhibiting ferroptosis through regulation of the p38/c-FOS/NF-kB pathway.
supplements.summary: A traditional herbal formula reduces chemotherapy-induced nerve pain by blocking a cellular damage pathway related to iron buildup.

supplements.title: Characterization of an Endophytic Fusarium odoratissimum Strain 25# from Dysosma versipellis with Putative Podophyllotoxin Production.
supplements.summary: Researchers identified a fungal strain that produces podophyllotoxin, a compound used to treat lymphoma, lung cancer, and leukemia, offering a sustainable alternative to endangered plant sources.

supplements.title: A pH-responsive hydrogel based on polysaccharides incorporated with honeysuckle-derived exosome-like nanovesicles for the management of infected wound.
supplements.summary: A honeysuckle-derived hydrogel gel kills bacteria, reduces inflammation, and promotes healing in infected wounds.

supplements.title: Molecular Mechanisms and Therapeutic Targets of Traditional Chinese Medicine Compounds in Renal Cell Carcinoma: A Comprehensive Narrative Review.
supplements.summary: Traditional Chinese Medicine compounds may complement standard treatments for renal cell carcinoma by targeting multiple pathways simultaneously while reducing toxicity.

supplements.title: Phytochemical Characterization, Molecular Docking, and Protective Efficacy of Cleome droserifolia Against Cisplatin-Induced Testicular Toxicity.
supplements.summary: A desert plant called Cleome droserifolia protects testicular tissue from damage caused by the cancer drug cisplatin.

supplements.title: Aloe emodin isolated from Cassiae semen upregulates IFITM1 to suppress hepatitis B virus replication via the interferon signaling pathway.
supplements.summary: Aloe emodin from Cassiae semen suppresses hepatitis B virus replication by activating the interferon immune response pathway.

supplements.title: Integrated transcriptomic analysis reveals a lncRNA-miRNA-TF-mRNA regulatory network underlying quercetin's anti-hepatocellular carcinoma effects.
supplements.summary: Quercetin fights hepatocellular carcinoma by activating a regulatory network that silences cancer-promoting genes.

supplements.title: Identifying PLAU as a shared pathogenic gene in type 2 diabetes and bladder urothelial carcinoma through integrated transcriptomic analysis and machine learning for diagnostic and therapeutic value.
supplements.summary: Researchers identified PLAU as a shared gene in type 2 diabetes and bladder cancer, finding that targeting it with EGCG compound may slow tumor growth.

off_label.title: Romosozumab for cancer treatment-induced bone loss in postmenopausal women with hormone receptor-positive breast cancer: a case series.
off_label.summary: Romosozumab improved bone strength in postmenopausal women with breast cancer experiencing treatment-related bone loss, without safety concerns observed.

off_label.title: Single-nucleus interrogation of primate small intestinal aging reveals NCoR1 decline as a conserved feature that is reversed by metformin.
off_label.summary: Metformin reverses age-related intestinal decline by restoring NCoR1 protein levels in primates and human cells.

off_label.title: The O‑GlcNAcase inhibition by Thiamet G disrupts the AngioMatrix signature of the Glioblastoma secretome in silico and impairs its angiogenic capacity in vitro.
off_label.summary: Thiamet G inhibitor reduces glioblastoma's ability to promote blood vessel formation, a potential new treatment strategy.

off_label.title: Fluoxetine-associated adverse event signals with a focus on seizure: A study based on the FAERS database, network pharmacology, and molecular docking.
off_label.summary: Fluoxetine, an antidepressant, shows increased seizure risk as a side effect based on FDA safety reports and molecular analysis.

off_label.title: Gut microbial metabolism of Flutamide attenuates its therapeutic efficacy against prostate cancer.
off_label.summary: Gut bacteria break down the prostate cancer drug Flutamide into inactive forms, reducing its effectiveness and suggesting personalized treatment approaches.

off_label.title: The metabolic plasticity of cancer stem cells: bidirectional crosstalk with organ-resident cells.
off_label.summary: Cancer stem cells adapt their metabolism through interactions with surrounding tissue cells, which could be targeted to overcome treatment resistance.

off_label.title: Repurposing ALK Inhibitors as Influenza and Corona Virus Antivirals Targeting Lymphocyte Tyrosine Kinase (LTK).
off_label.summary: Existing cancer drugs that inhibit ALK show promise as antivirals against influenza and COVID-19 by targeting a host cell protein viruses need.

off_label.title: Orbital Myiasis Secondary to Neglected Medial Canthal Basal Cell Carcinoma Caused by Chrysomya bezziana.
off_label.summary: Untreated basal cell carcinoma of the eye allowed fly larvae to infest the orbit, successfully treated with larvae removal, antibiotics, and ivermectin.

off_label.title: Attenuation of ABCG2-dependent drug efflux by befotertinib restores chemosensitivity in multidrug-resistant non-small cell lung cancer cells.
off_label.summary: Befotertinib, an EGFR inhibitor, restores chemotherapy effectiveness in drug-resistant lung cancer by blocking a protein that pumps drugs out of tumor cells.

off_label.title: DPP-4 inhibitor alleviates gut-brain axis pathology in Parkinson's disease.
off_label.summary: DPP-4 inhibitor drugs reduce Parkinson's disease symptoms by blocking harmful protein transmission from the gut to the brain.

off_label.title: Pulmonary Hydatid Cyst Rupture Associated With Albendazole Commencement: Case Report and Literature Review.
off_label.summary: Albendazole treatment for pulmonary hydatid cysts may cause dangerous rupture within three weeks of starting therapy.

off_label.title: GLP-1 Receptor Agonists and Primary Prevention of Cancer Therapy-Related Cardiac Dysfunction.
off_label.summary: GLP-1 drugs reduced heart damage risk by half in cancer patients receiving toxic chemotherapy, across multiple cancer types.

off_label.title: Targeting the Calcineurin Homologous Protein 1 (CHP1)-Transmembrane Protein 87A (TMEM87A) mechanosensing complex: a druggable vulnerability in metastatic ovarian cancer.
off_label.summary: Researchers identified a protein complex in ovarian cancer that enables metastasis, and sodium gluconate treatment successfully reduced tumor spread in mice.

off_label.title: An Agentic Platform for Drug Repurposing Unified across Molecular, Phenotypic, and Clinical Scales.
off_label.summary: LinkD, a new AI platform, identifies existing drugs that work against cancer by analyzing molecular, cellular, and patient data together.

off_label.title: CA7 overexpression enhances the anti-tumor effects of propofol in colorectal cancer via JAK2/STAT3 pathway.
off_label.summary: CA7 protein boosts propofol's cancer-fighting effects in colorectal cancer by blocking a specific growth pathway.

biomarkers.title: Mes/Stem-A ovarian cancer subtypes predict sensitivity to ATR inhibition.
biomarkers.summary: Mesenchymal and Stem-A ovarian cancer subtypes show high replication stress and respond well to ATR inhibitor treatment.

trials.title: Safety and Effectiveness of an Integrative Treatment of Acupuncture-Based Intervention in Survivors of Breast Cancer With Postmastectomy Pain Syndrome: Protocol for a Single-Center, Single-Arm Exploratory Trial.
trials.summary: Researchers are testing acupuncture as a potential treatment for chronic pain in breast cancer surgery survivors.

trials.title: Depression and psycho-existential correlates in cancer outpatients: A longitudinal real-life study.
trials.summary: Depression is common in cancer patients and linked to worse outcomes, quality of life, and treatment adherence.

trials.summary: Researchers are testing whether adding radiation therapy to hormone treatment improves outcomes in prostate cancer patients with limited lymph node recurrence.

trials.title: Surgery or radiotherapy for early-stage cancer study protocol for an emulated target trial of radical radiotherapy versus radical cystectomy, with either following neoadjuvant chemotherapy, for organ-confined muscle-invasive bladder cancer.
trials.summary: Researchers will compare surgery versus radiation therapy for early-stage bladder cancer, both following chemotherapy, using observational data analysis.

trials.title: Imaging Modality and Outcomes of Metastasis-Directed Therapy in Oligometastatic Castration-Resistant Prostate Cancer: An Updated Analysis of the PRECISE-MDT Cohort.
trials.summary: PSMA PET/CT imaging improves survival outcomes compared to other imaging methods when guiding treatment for oligometastatic castration-resistant prostate cancer.

trials.title: GSH-Activatable Rare-Earth Nanoprobe for NIR-II Fluorescence Imaging-Guided Surgery and Enhanced Chemotherapy/Chemodynamic Therapy of Breast Cancer.
trials.summary: Researchers developed a nanoparticle probe that glows in tumors to guide breast cancer surgery and simultaneously releases chemotherapy drugs for enhanced treatment.

trials.title: Pt(IV) Complexes Incorporating CDC25A/NF-κB Dual Inhibitory 1,4-Naphthoquinone Derivatives Trigger Multimodal Cell Death in A2780 Ovarian Cancer Cells.
trials.summary: A new platinum drug candidate effectively kills ovarian cancer cells through multiple mechanisms and shows superior tumor control compared to standard cisplatin treatment.

trials.title: Sociodemographic Paradoxes and Enrollment Differences in In-Person Versus Online Recruitment to a Mobile Health Smoking Cessation Intervention for Food-Insecure Adults: Secondary Analysis of a Randomized Controlled Trial.
trials.summary: A smoking cessation mobile health program recruited food-insecure adults differently through in-person versus online methods, with important demographic variations between groups.

trials.title: Patient and oncologist expectations of functional prognosis among older adults with acute myeloid leukemia.
trials.summary: Older AML patients expect better physical function than their oncologists predict, but a decision-support tool reduced this dangerous gap.

trials.title: Romosozumab for cancer treatment-induced bone loss in postmenopausal women with hormone receptor-positive breast cancer: a case series.
trials.summary: Romosozumab improved bone strength in postmenopausal women with breast cancer experiencing treatment-related bone loss, without safety concerns observed.

trials.title: Potentiating mild photothermal therapy via CDK12/13-mediated AKT suppression to orchestrate ferroptosis-apoptosis crosstalk for vaccine-like immunity.
trials.summary: Researchers combined mild heat therapy with a drug blocking CDK12/13 to trigger cancer cell death and activate immune responses against tumors.

trials.title: The longitudinal effects of faith and meaning on quality of life in US women with breast cancer undergoing chemotherapy.
trials.summary: Strong faith and sense of meaning improve quality of life for breast cancer patients receiving chemotherapy.

trials.title: Effect of yoga on musculoskeletal complaints in women during endocrine treatment for breast cancer: protocol of the randomised controlled COBRA trial.
trials.summary: A study tests whether yoga reduces muscle and joint pain in women taking long-term breast cancer medications.
